Let me check what's actually in your src folder.## What is `frontend/src`?
`src` (short for **source**) is where **all your actual code lives**. This is what you write and edit.
---
### Your EthioVuln `src` structure:
``` src/ ├── app/ ← Pages (what users see at each URL) ├── components/ ← Reusable UI pieces ├── hooks/ ← Shared React logic ├── lib/ ← API client & utilities └── types/ ← TypeScript type definitions ```
---
### Each folder explained:
#### `app/` — Pages Every folder = a URL route: ``` app/page.tsx → / (landing page) app/login/page.tsx → /login app/register/page.tsx → /register app/about/page.tsx → /about app/dashboard/page.tsx → /dashboard app/dashboard/scans/page.tsx → /dashboard/scans app/dashboard/scans/new/page.tsx → /dashboard/scans/new app/dashboard/scans/[id]/page.tsx → /dashboard/scans/abc123 app/dashboard/reports/page.tsx → /dashboard/reports app/dashboard/settings/page.tsx → /dashboard/settings app/layout.tsx → wraps ALL pages app/globals.css → global styles app/error.tsx → error page app/not-found.tsx → 404 page ```
#### `components/` — Reusable UI pieces ``` PageNav.tsx ← back/forward navigation bar (used across multiple pages) ```
#### `hooks/` — Shared React logic ``` useAuth.tsx ← handles login/logout/user state useWebSocket.ts ← handles live scan WebSocket connection ```
#### `lib/` — Utilities & API ``` api.ts ← talks to backend (all HTTP requests) settingsApi.ts ← settings-specific API calls constants.ts ← shared values (colors, labels, URLs) cvss.ts ← CVSS score helpers ```
#### `types/` — TypeScript definitions ``` scan.ts ← Scan, ScanStatus, ScanType shapes user.ts ← User, LoginRequest, TokenResponse shapes vulnerability.ts ← Vulnerability, Severity shapes ```
---
### Simple rule:
``` src/app/ → what the user SEES (pages) src/lib/ → how it WORKS (API, logic) src/hooks/ → shared BEHAVIOR (auth, websocket) src/types/ → data SHAPES (TypeScript) src/components/ → reusable UI PIECES ```
Everything in `src/` gets **compiled by Next.js** into the `.next/` folder when you run `npm run dev`.
